children: Williams Companies, Inc. (NYSE:WMB) raised $2.75B via four senior notes to refinance short-term debt and fund capex as it closes the $5.5B Momentum Midstream deal adding ~6 Bcf/d Haynesville capacity, while a Third Circuit vacatur of NJ water certification is being managed and analysts update $85 targets.
: Williams (WMB) sold $2.75B of senior unsecured notes across four tranches (2029, 2033, 2036, 2056) at ~99.8–99.999% par to repay commercial paper and fund capex.
: Williams completed its $5.5B purchase of Momentum Midstream, adding ~6 Bcf/d Haynesville gathering capacity and expanding WMB’s Gulf Coast-proximate gas gathering and throughput.
NESE Pipeline NJ Water Cert Vacated
: Third Circuit vacated New Jersey water certification for Williams Companies’ NESE pipeline; WMB is working with regulators and says the ruling won’t affect construction or the project timeline
: Analyst updates for Williams Companies (WMB): Stifel set a $85 price target; Scotiabank cut its target to $85 from $86. Traders: note updated price targets and recent revision.
